about: DCM Shriram Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in agri-rural, chemicals and vinyl, and value added businesses in India and internationally. It operates through Chemicals and Vinyl, Sugar and Ethanol, Fenesta Building System, Shriram Farm solutions, Fertiliser, Bioseed, and Others segments.
